crm_notes: Lead source: inbound website / free trial. Product fit: SMB helpdesk automation, primary intent to use hosted API for MVP. Initial ask (CTO Maya Lin): 'Please send SOC2 Type II and list of subprocessors — our legal team requires these before production traffic.' Security specifics requested: full SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 summary), DPA with EU data residency clause and standard data processing terms, redacted sub-processor CSV, encryption at rest + TLS details, KMS options (customer-managed?); data deletion and retention APIs and SLA, audit log availability. Tech/traffic: expected ~100k tokens/month initial; spiky bursts during ticket surges; latency target 95p ~150-300ms; cost sensitivity — target avg <$0.0006/token. POC approach: route non-sensitive traffic to hosted API, pilot for 4 weeks, evaluate rollout. From SE call 2026-03-03: shared quickstart cURL, example batching recommendations, content filters overview. Legal asked to review DPA and return edits by EOW. Action items: send SOC2 + redacted sub-processor list, attach DPA template and call out negotiable vs non-negotiable clauses, schedule 30-min security Q&A with CTO + Head of Ops, validate billing card on file. Notes & quote: 'We just need the legal boxes ticked before we roll to customers — small team, can't deep-host now.' Risk: procurement may delay if DPA requires immediate EU-only residency that hosted cannot yet guarantee. Related artifacts shared: pricing deck, SOC2 summary, DPA draft. Status: warm inbound, SMB cadence (~2-6 weeks), high intent to run hosted API for MVP in Q2.
